title: BUILD-SITE-065-glossary-and-methodology-boundary-pages
universal_lens: The boundary-layer operator acts as a projection matrix onto a public subspace, strictly filtering high-dimensional proprietary methodology vectors. It enforces an epistemic manifold where user-facing trust metrics are mathematically decoupled from underlying generative priors, ensuring structural isomorphism between product clarity and legal compliance constraints.
gsi_mapping: GSI treats the glossary boundary as a conformal prediction filter. By projecting raw Bayesian posterior probabilities into bounded, human-readable confidence intervals, it guarantees coverage while masking exact model weights. This prevents overfitting to noisy sportsbook lines and ensures calibration across diverse market regimes without exposing core inference kernels.
gse_mapping: In GSE, the boundary defines strict state-transition rules for situational reasoning. The engine maps complex tactical priors into simplified, actionable surface signals. This isolates the internal Markov decision process from external observation, preventing adversarial exploitation of the underlying game-theoretic state space while maintaining optimal user engagement trajectories.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This framework inherits from Shannon's information theory regarding channel capacity and noise, extended into modern differential privacy. reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: We model the user as a rational agent seeking maximum predictive utility with minimum cognitive effort. Opposing actors include regulators aiming to minimize harm and competitors attempting to reverse-engineer our edge. The boundary layer anticipates these intents, presenting a curated reality that satisfies the user's need for clarity, the regulator's demand for safety, and the firm's requirement for intellectual property protection simultaneously.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: Anti-collinearity is enforced by ensuring the public glossary vectors are not linearly dependent on the private methodology vectors. If a new feature introduces a correlation between UI phrasing and internal model weights exceeding a threshold epsilon, the Compliance Constraint Kernel triggers a veto. This prevents adversarial agents from using the public site as an oracle to extract proprietary betting strategies or exploit blind spots in our situational reasoning engine.
